settings.mediaServers.title: Media servers
settings.mediaServers.name: Name
settings.mediaServers.plexTokenHint: The token of your Plex server. Kept encrypted and never shown again; leave empty to keep the stored one. A new address needs it typed again.
settings.mediaServers.apiKeyHint: Make one in the server: Dashboard, API keys. Kept encrypted and never shown again; leave empty to keep the stored one. A new address needs it typed again.
settings.mediaServers.subsonicHint: Use an account that may start a library scan. HolyArrs asks for a full scan after new music arrives. The password is kept encrypted; leave empty to keep it.
settings.mediaServers.kodiHint: The user name and password of Kodi's web server. HolyArrs asks Kodi to scan each new folder and to clean out removed ones. The password is kept encrypted; leave empty to keep it.
settings.mediaServers.pathHint: Only if the server sees your files under another path
settings.mediaServers.webUrlHint: Where people open the server on their phone or computer. Adds an Open in button to the title pages it has. Leave empty to use the address above, unless only HolyArrs can reach it (like http://jellyfin:8096).
settings.mediaServers.plainHint: Sends the password itself, not the safer salted sign-in. Turn on only if the server checks passwords with LDAP. Needs an https or local address.
settings.mediaServers.noneText: New titles show up in Plex, Jellyfin, Emby or Navidrome (and other Subsonic servers) by themselves.
settings.mediaServers.watchHint: Shows who watched what on Library stats, for people who run the Library. Off deletes what was read.
settings.mediaServers.watchConfirmOff: Turn off watch history? Everything read so far is deleted.
settings.mediaServers.watchTurnedOn: Watch history on. The first read comes within 30 minutes.
settings.mediaServers.labelHint: When a requested movie or show is in Plex, HolyArrs adds a label to it, so you can filter, build collections or share by it in Plex. Labels already there stay.
settings.mediaServers.labelAskers: Also add the requester's name as a label
settings.mediaServers.labelExistingStart: Labelling started. Titles get their labels within a few minutes.
settings.mediaServers.tracksSwitch: Pick the audio and subtitle languages
settings.mediaServers.tracksHint: Your media server starts each movie and episode in the first language on your list that the file has.
settings.mediaServers.tracksJellyHint: Plex: set on every file, for the Plex account HolyArrs signs in with. Jellyfin and Emby: everyone who hasn't picked their own languages gets the first one on each list.
settings.mediaServers.tracksSavedBody: Files get their languages within a few minutes.
settings.mediaServers.tracksFailed: Couldn't save default audio and subtitles
settings.mediaServers.plexNotLinked: Link your Plex account in Settings > Sign-in to pick from your servers.
settings.mediaServers.plexUsesSignIn: Uses your Plex sign-in, so no token is needed.
